results.title: Uluwatu Temple - The Iconic Cliffside Temple of Bali
results.content:
Uluwatu Temple is open daily from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM. The Kecak Dance performance starts at 6:00 PM, with gates opening at 4:00 PM.

International Visitors: Adult IDR 50,000 | Child IDR 30,000   
 Domestic Visitors: Adult IDR 30,000 | Child IDR 20,000   
 Kecak Dance Ticket: Adult IDR 150,000 | Child IDR 75,000

As a sacred site, visitors must wear a sarong and sash, which are provided at the entrance. Dress modestly and cover your shoulders and knees.

## Why Visit Uluwatu Temple in 2026? [...] ## Frequently Asked Questions About Uluwatu Temple 2026

Uluwatu Temple 2026 FAQ Bali temple visitor questions

Uluwatu Temple is one of the most asked-about temple experiences in Bali. Photo source: Pexels.

### Is Uluwatu Temple worth visiting in 2026?

Yes. Uluwatu Temple is worth visiting for its cliffside ocean view, sunset scenery, sacred temple atmosphere, monkeys, and Kecak Dance performance.

### What time does Uluwatu Temple open?

Uluwatu Temple opens daily from 07:00 to 19:00. [...] The Uluwatu Kecak Dance is one of Bali’s most famous evening performances. It presents the Ramayana story with rhythmic chanting, dramatic movement, and a sunset ocean backdrop.

 Showtime: 18:00–19:00 daily
 Open gate: 16:00
 Adult ticket: IDR 150,000
 Child ticket: IDR 75,000
 Recommended arrival: Before 17:00 for better seats

Tickets may sell out during peak travel dates. If watching the Kecak Dance is your priority, arrive early or book a tour package that helps arrange the timing.

Uluwatu Temple, also called Pura Luhur Uluwatu, is one of Bali’s six key temples. The name means divine origin. This Uluwatu guide explains why the site is worth a visit and what makes it special.

The temple is best known for its cliff-top setting. It stands on a steep cliff about 70 metres above the sea. At sunset, the view is one of the best in Bali.

results.title: The Complete Guide To Uluwatu Temple: Everything You ...
results.content:
You can visit Uluwatu Temple at any time of the year. While it’s slightly cooler and less likely to rain during the dry season, it’s fine to go during the wet season (it doesn’t rain all day long), and the humidity isn’t unbearable.

## When Is Uluwatu Temple Open?

The opening hours at Uluwatu Temple are from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day of the year. [...] Please be aware that during Balinese festivals, this temple can get very busy, indeed, as it’s an active place of worship and not something preserved to keep tourists happy.

In fact, Balinese pilgrims are allowed access to the temple 24 hours a day for them to be able to carry out their rituals and ceremonies as needed. [...] You may also find that the opening hours can be modified at Uluwatu Temple depending on what’s going on – it’s worth checking before you travel to see if there have been any changes.

## How Much Is It To Get Into Uluwatu Temple?

As we go to press, the entrance fees at Uluwatu Temple are based on two things – your nationality and your age.

International tourists are asked to pay 50,000 IDR as adults and 20,000 for children aged 6-12. Children under 6 enter for free.
